_meta.note: Core strings only. Gujarati, Tamil and Telugu shipped before the client named six languages on 2026-09-22, and are kept because removing a language somebody may already have chosen is a product decision, not a tidy-up. They are NOT in PRIORITY_LOCALES, so the coverage test does not hold them to the full key set; every product string falls back to English per key until a translator fills them in. `i18n.missing_keys(code)` lists exactly what is absent.
